title: PyPI password stored in the publish configuration
description: .pypirc declares a PyPI password written directly into the checked-in `.pypirc`. Repository readers can publish as the account, and the credential cannot be scoped or expired like an API token.
remediation: Use a scoped API token read from the environment, and rotate the password.
limitation: It matches a PyPI password written directly into the checked-in `.pypirc` in the parsed .pypirc; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
